description: Dependency update pull requests for nginx-static: GitHub Actions and the tools the workflows install, NGINX and the Alpine the base image is built with, the k3s of the page Try it locally, the documentation site's npm packages. The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases. tests/ci/test.sh guards what the bot updates and what stays manual.

helm-values.description: No values file pins an image for the bot to follow: the chart's own names the base image at the chart's version, and the files under examples/sites/ name images of a private registry.

helmv3.description: The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases.

customManagers.description: Tool versions of the workflows, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.

The NGINX the base image is built from: NGINX_VERSION in docker/Dockerfile, and appVersion in chart/Chart.yaml, which names the same version; one pull request moves both, and the template test fails when they differ. Stable releases only, the ones with an even minor.
The k3s image the page Try it locally creates its k3d cluster with; try-locally.yml runs the page's command. Only releases: no rc tags, no tags of one architecture.

packageRules.description: Release tags of the pinned tools carry a v prefix, the pins do not.
A new digest under the same version means a release tag was moved: approve it on the dashboard after a look at the commit.
The Renovate that renovate-config.yml runs, once a month: Renovate releases most days.

prBodyNotes: The job `hadolint` fails until `HADOLINT_SHA256` in .github/workflows/test.yml is the sum of `hadolint-linux-x86_64` in https://github.com/hadolint/hadolint/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/checksums.sha256.

The job `oras` fails until `ORAS_SHA256` in .github/actions/setup-oras/action.yml is the sum of `oras_{{{newVersion}}}_linux_amd64.tar.gz` in https://github.com/oras-project/oras/releases/download/v{{{newVersion}}}/oras_{{{newVersion}}}_checksums.txt.

packageRules.description: The k3d of the job try-locally.yml; its pull request runs that job.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/ci/test.sh fails until "Tested with k3d …" in examples/k3d/README.md names it.

packageRules.description: The k3s of the page Try it locally; its pull request runs the job try-locally.yml.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/ci/test.sh fails until "Tested with k3d … and k3s …" in examples/k3d/README.md names it.

packageRules.description: The documentation site's npm packages (site/), once a month; its pull requests build the site.
The override in site/package.json keeps VitePress 1 on a vite 6 that has the fixes. A new vite major comes with a VitePress release that asks for it, not on its own.
A new NGINX is a change to the image and to the chart's appVersion.
prBodyNotes: This changes the NGINX the base image is built from: add a line under `## Unreleased` in chart/CHANGELOG.md before merging. The build checks the source against the keys in docker/keys/; a release signed with a key that is not there fails the job `smoke-test` until the key from https://nginx.org/en/pgp_keys.html is added.

packageRules.description: A new NGINX stable branch (1.30 to 1.32) waits for approval on the dashboard: a deliberate move, like a new Alpine release below.

The Alpine the base image is built with. Its digest moves often and changes nothing by itself, since every release installs the packages afresh: once a month. A new Alpine release waits for approval on the dashboard.
